title: M1.0: Land the contract doc and register the narrative
description:
Decide with the owner how docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md lands (docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.md, cross-links from MESSAGING.md, ORGANIZATIONS.md and APPROVAL.md) and add a features/external_channels_narrative note listing the planned features in reading order. Docs are product and land by pull request into develop, not with the board.

Acceptance criteria:
- docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.md exists and matches the owner's answers to the open questions
- MESSAGING.md links to it from the section on bot to bot and the HTTP surface
- No third-party agent product is named as a model
- README untouched (no status section)

Gherkin: none (infrastructure or owner task); infra tests or a runbook are the evidence.

Depends on: owner answers to the open questions on the initiative

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).
